messages:
mina: FYI bringing voyager-v1 int8 onboard. Quick smoke shows a weird detok artifact: CJK corner quotes around a Chinese phrase are swapped when the source contains an Arabic/RTL fragment immediately before the quote. Repro below.

lee: can you drop the exact model/tokenizer + smallest repro? is this only in int8/staging?

mina: Model: voyager-v1 quantized -> int8 (qk-1). Tokenizer: voyager-sp (shared sentencepiece). Repro appears on both local int8 and staging canary. float32 path decodes correctly.

mina: Minimal repro (copy-paste):
```
# prompt to model
Translate to zh: "He said \"Good morning\" in Arabic: \u0635\u0628\u0627\u062d \u0627\u0644\u062e\u064a\u0631"
# expected snippet: 他說：『早上好』
# actual on int8:   他說：』早上好『  <-- corner quotes flipped
```

yusuf: odd. are token ids preserved around the quote tokens?

mina: ran tokenizer roundtrip:
```
from redwood.tokenizer import Tokenizer
tok = Tokenizer('voyager-sp')
s = "\u0635\u0628\u0627\u062d \u0627\u0644\u062e\u064a\u0631 \u2018\u65e9\u4e0a\u597d\u2019"
ids = tok.encode(s)
print(ids)
print(tok.decode(ids))
```
Int8 runtime decode -> "他說：』早上好『"  (ids sequence matches float32 run)

toby: if ids match then detok table/kernel likely reorders codepoints when bidi context flag present. Could be a fused detok kernel bug on the int8 path.

sasha: try --no-bidi-normalize and also run with alternate detok table (table_v2) to see if it changes. Add small unit test to token-diff-suite once we have deterministic repro.

mina: tried --no-bidi-normalize, no change. Switching to table_v2 on int8 returns correct quotes, so it's probably table_v3+detok_fuse_v2 interaction.

ci-bot: artifact: /runs/1768891234/voyager-int8-smoke (200 mixed-locale samples). chrF: 0.783 -> 0.719, BLEU small drop, failures concentrated on CJK-with-RTL group.

lee: thanks. @yusuf can you bisect detok_fuse_v2 and table_v3 changes? smallest failing sample would be great for automated bisect.

yusuf: starting bisect now. initial findings: commit 4f2c9a5 in detok_fuse_v2 introduced a conditional reordering when has_rtl flag true. Locally the repro reproduces with that commit. Preparing a revert PR + unit test.

mina: can we add a canonical mixed-orient quote case into translation-regressions so future quant builds hit this? Also add a roundtrip smoke comparing token->char for both float32 and int8 for mixed-locale inputs.

sasha: agreed. I'll create ENG-ML ticket and track rollback/hotfix/rollout. Assigning @yusuf to PR and @lee to run post-patch evals.

infra-bot: canary deploy voyager-int8-hotfix to ppool-3 started at 1768890450 by yusuf

yusuf: hotfix: force detok_fuse_v2 to pick table_v2 when has_rtl=true while we revert the reorder logic. Pushing PR now.

mina: canary check in ~10m. will rerun minimal repro and the 200-sample smoke.

infra-bot: canary deploy complete on ppool-3 at 1768890850

mina: canary result: minimal repro fixed, 200-sample chrF returned to 0.781. marking as tentative fix.

lee: please link PR/commit and open regression ticket. we'll schedule full staged rollout after regression tests pass. :thumbsup:

sasha: created ENG-ML-1428: "voyager-int8 mixed-orientation detok flip with RTL prefix". Links: PR yusuf/1770, revert 4f2c9a5. Keep updates here.
